# Udaan Edu Loans — Knowledge Base & Platform Overview
> Udaan Edu Loans (udaaneduloans.com) is India's premier overseas education loan advisory and aggregation platform. It facilitates secured (property/FD-backed) and unsecured (collateral-free) study abroad loans up to ₹1.5 Crore across 30+ partner public commercial banks, private banks, NBFCs, and global fintech lenders for Indian students pursuing Master's, MBA, STEM, and undergraduate degrees globally.

---

## 1. Entity Definition & Regulatory Role
- **Legal Entity:** Udaan Edu Loans Facilitators Pvt. Ltd.
- **Operating Role:** Authorized Direct Selling Agent (DSA) and institutional education loan facilitator.
- **Business Model:** 100% free consultation and advisory for students. Udaan receives institutional origination commissions directly from partnered financial institutions upon loan disbursement. Zero processing fees or service charges are collected from students or co-applicants.
- **Founding Headquarters:** Level 4, Cyber City, DLF Phase 2, Gurugram, Haryana 122002, India.
- **Contact Channels:** Helpline: +91 7303200803, +91 7303200804 | Official Email: connect@udaaneduloans.com | Web: https://www.udaaneduloans.com

---

## 2. Core Services & Advisory Portfolio
1. **Collateral-Free Education Loans:** Unsecured student loans up to ₹75 Lakhs without hypothecation of immovable property, based on student academic merit, standardized test scores (GRE/GMAT/IELTS), university ranking, and co-applicant income.
2. **Secured Education Loans:** Property-backed loans up to ₹1.5 Crore utilizing residential flats, non-agricultural land, commercial plots, or Fixed Deposits (FDs) with interest rates starting from 8.15% p.a.
3. **Pre-Visa & Pre-Admit Sanction Letters:** Fast 3 to 7 working day sanctions compliant with foreign embassy visa guidelines (US F-1 Form I-20, Germany Sperrkonto, Canada IRCC GIC, UK CAS 28-day funds, Australia Genuine Student criteria).
4. **German Blocked Account (Sperrkonto) Financing:** Seamless direct international loan remittance into German Federal Foreign Office-approved accounts (Coracle, Expatrio, Fintiba) to fulfill the €11,904 annual living expense requirement.
5. **Canadian GIC Direct Disbursement:** Direct loan transfer of CAD $20,635 living cost funds into designated Canadian financial institutions (CIBC, Scotiabank, ICICI Bank Canada).
6. **Section 80E Tax Optimization Advisory:** Structuring co-applicant loan liability to maximize 100% tax deduction on education loan interest paid over 8 consecutive financial years with no upper monetary cap.

## 4. Underwriting & Eligibility Criteria

### Student Borrower Criteria
- **Citizenship:** Indian national with valid Indian passport.
- **Academic Qualifications:** Minimum 55%–60% aggregate in 10th, 12th, and Undergraduate degree. Backlogs accepted with justification statement (SOP).
- **Target Degrees:** Master's (MS/MSc), MBA, Master of Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Healthcare, and select Bachelor's degrees.
- **Admission Status:** Confirmed admit, conditional offer, or university shortlist from an accredited international university.

### Co-Applicant & Cosigner Criteria
- **Eligible Primary Co-Applicants:** Father, Mother, Spouse, Siblings. (Select NBFCs accept paternal/maternal uncles, aunts, or legal guardians).
- **Credit Benchmark:** Minimum CIBIL score of 685. Scores of 750+ unlock preferential interest rates (25–50 bps concession).
- **Fixed Obligation to Income Ratio (FOIR):** Maximum 50% to 65% of net monthly take-home salary after factoring existing EMIs.
- **Minimum Net Monthly Salary:** ₹35,000/month for salaried; ₹4.5 Lakhs annual net profit for self-employed/business co-applicants.

### Collateral Asset Criteria (For Secured Loans)
- **Approved Assets:** Residential houses/flats, commercial shops/offices, non-agricultural approved layout plots, and bank Fixed Deposits.
- **Required Documents:** Registered title deed (minimum 13 to 30 years chain of title), encumbrance certificate (Form 15/16), approved municipal building plan, property tax receipts, and advocate legal scrutiny report.
- **Loan-to-Value (LTV):** Up to 80%–90% of real estate market valuation; up to 90%–95% of bank Fixed Deposit face value.

---

## 5. Country-Specific Visa Financial Proof Standards

### 1. United States (F-1 Visa)
- **University I-20 Requirement:** Liquid proof of funds equal to 1st year tuition + living expenses as listed on Form I-20.
- **Acceptable Proof:** Bank sanction letter from RBI-recognized bank/NBFC, bank savings balances, and FD certificates.
- **Consular Visa Interview:** Official sanction letter must specify total sanctioned amount, lender name, and confirmation that funds are available for disbursement upon visa grant.

### 2. Germany (Student Visa)
- **Blocked Account Requirement:** €11,904/year (~₹11 Lakhs) deposited into a German Federal Foreign Office-approved Sperrkonto provider (Coracle, Expatrio, or Fintiba).
- **Tuition Situation:** Public universities charge zero tuition (only €150–€350/semester administrative fee).
- **APS Certificate:** Mandatory APS (Akademische Prüfstelle) verification certificate before visa submission for Indian graduates.

### 3. Canada (Study Permit)
- **IRCC Requirements:** Full first-year tuition fee receipt + Guaranteed Investment Certificate (GIC) valued at CAD $20,635 from approved Canadian banks (CIBC, Scotiabank, ICICI Canada).
- **Loan Solution:** Direct lender wire transfer to purchase Canadian GIC and remit first-semester tuition directly to DLI college/university.

### 4. United Kingdom (Student Route Visa)
- **CAS & 28-Day Holding Rule:** Total course fees as specified on CAS + UKVI maintenance funds (£1,334/month for London; £1,023/month outside London for up to 9 months).
- **Sanction Letter Exemption:** If funded via an official educational loan sanction letter from an RBI-regulated bank, the 28-day bank balance holding requirement is waived under UKVI Appendix Finance.

### 5. Australia (Subclass 500 Visa)
- **Financial Capacity Proof:** 1st year tuition fees + living costs (AUD $29,710/year) + return airfare (~AUD $2,000).
- **Department of Home Affairs Criteria:** Unconditional education loan sanction letters from scheduled commercial banks are accepted as primary evidence of funds.

---

## 6. Section 80E Indian Income Tax Deductions
- **Eligible Borrowers:** Individual taxpayers paying interest on an education loan taken for self, spouse, or children.
- **Deduction Scope:** 100% of the interest amount paid during the financial year can be deducted from gross total income. There is NO upper financial ceiling.
- **Duration:** Available for up to 8 consecutive assessment years starting from the year repayment commences.
- **Lender Caveat:** The loan MUST be sanctioned by a scheduled commercial bank or approved financial institution under the Banking Regulation Act. Foreign/USD-denominated lenders (e.g., Prodigy Finance, MPOWER) DO NOT qualify for Section 80E benefits.
